title: Partially Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computation for Megaquop Applications
summary: Partially fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) has recently emerged as a promising approach for the execution of megaquop-scale circuits with millions of logical operations. In this work, we demonstrate the strengths and the limitations of this approach by conducting quantum resource estimation (QRE) of the space--time-efficient analog rotation (STAR) architecture using realistic hardware specifications for superconducting processors, and compare it against the QRE of the full FTQC architecture.
